Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square photo-baked face UV texture for a PS1/early-PS2 adult game NPC, to be reduced to 128x128.
Primary request: create one full-bleed flat front orthographic facial texture of a distinct adult woman age 35, European ancestry, natural slightly tired everyday features, light warm skin, subtle freckles, brown eyes, auburn hairline confined to the very top edge. She has shoulder-length auburn bob hair in the game, but this is FACE SKIN ONLY.
Composition/framing: perfectly frontal and symmetrical camera, zero head turn or perspective; crop from forehead hairline at the top border down through the chin at the bottom border, cheek skin reaching the left and right borders. No neck, no shoulders, no background, no portrait framing. Eyes open, neutral relaxed closed mouth. Forehead, both eyebrows, eyes, nose, lips and chin all present. Eye centers near x 0.28 and 0.72, image y 0.35; nose tip near y 0.61; mouth center near y 0.77; chin near y 0.96. Broad cheek skin suitable for wrapping around low-poly geometry.
Style/medium: believable photograph baked into a vintage low-resolution game texture. Flat diffuse light, gentle baked eye-socket and nose shading, restrained muted colors, visibly blocky photo detail at the eventual 128 pixel resolution. Natural pores and slight uneven skin tone. No beauty retouching.
Constraints: no hair locks across forehead or cheeks, no glossy makeup, no eyeliner, no glamor, no anime, no cartoon, no painted illustration, no 3D model render, no ears sticking into the frame, no borders, no labels, no text, no watermark. The entire canvas is usable face skin rather than a person on a backdrop.
